description: Move admin index route closures into controllers (A-2) and add the missing compatibility_rules FK constraints via a NEW migration (#14). Keep route names/URLs identical and behind Phase 1 admin middleware; driver-guard the FK migration for sqlite. Independent of all engine features; depends on FEAT-001 factories for tests.
steps: Move the three inline Route::get(fn()=>...) closures in routes/web.php (admin.configurations.index, admin.quotations.index, admin.audit-logs.index) into controller methods consistent with the existing Admin controller pattern (see DashboardController). Suggested: new App\Http\Controllers\Admin\ConfigurationController@index (ConfigurationSession::with(['product','user'])->latest()->paginate(20) -> view('admin.configurations.index',...)); reuse/extend QuotationAdminController with index() (QuotationRequest::with(['configuration.product'])->latest()->paginate(20) -> view('admin.quotations.index',...)); new App\Http\Controllers\Admin\AuditLogController@index (AuditLog::with('user')->latest()->paginate(50) -> view('admin.audit-logs.index',...)). Keep the exact queries, view names, and compact vars. Keep all three inside the existing admin group middleware ['auth','role:super_admin|product_manager']; do NOT change names or URLs. Use 'php artisan make:controller --no-interaction'. Add explicit return types.

Create a NEW migration (php artisan make:migration add_foreign_keys_to_compatibility_rules --no-interaction) adding FKs for compatibility_rules.option_id and target_option_id referencing attribute_options(id) with cascadeOnDelete (matching the sibling attribute_id FK on the same table). DRIVER-GUARD it: in up() and down(), if the connection driver is 'sqlite', return early (sqlite cannot ALTER-add FKs) with a PHPDoc comment explaining the limitation; apply the FKs only on mysql/pgsql. Do NOT edit the existing migration.

Add tests/Feature/AdminIndexRoutesTest.php (Pest, seed RolesAndPermissionsSeeder): a super_admin gets 200 on admin.configurations.index, admin.quotations.index, admin.audit-logs.index; a customer gets 403 on each (Phase 1 preserved). Run Pint, the targeted test, then the full suite (which migrates fresh on sqlite — the FK migration must be a clean no-op there).
acceptance_criteria: No route closure remains for the three admin index routes; route:list shows controller actions and the names/URLs are unchanged.
An admin (super_admin) can load all three index pages (200); a customer is forbidden (403) — Phase 1 authorization preserved (AdminIndexRoutesTest passes).
A new migration adds the two compatibility_rules FKs on mysql/pgsql and is a documented no-op on sqlite; the existing migration is untouched.
The full suite migrates cleanly on sqlite and stays green.
findings:
DONE. Full suite green: 52 passed (116 assertions). Targeted AdminIndexRoutesTest: 6 passed.

=== Closures moved to controllers (routes/web.php) ===
The three inline Route::get(fn()=>...) admin index closures are gone. route:list confirms admin.configurations.index -> Admin\ConfigurationController@index. All three stay inside the existing admin group middleware ['auth','role:super_admin|product_manager']; names and URLs unchanged (admin/configurations, admin/quotations, admin/audit-logs).
- NEW app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ConfigurationController@index(): View -> ConfigurationSession::with(['product','user'])->latest()->paginate(20) -> view('admin.configurations.index', compact('configurations')).
- NEW app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AuditLogController@index(): View -> AuditLog::with('user')->latest()->paginate(50) -> view('admin.audit-logs.index', compact('logs')).
- QuotationAdminController extended with index(): View -> QuotationRequest::with(['configuration.product'])->latest()->paginate(20) -> view('admin.quotations.index', compact('quotations')). updateStatus() untouched.
Exact queries/view names/compact vars preserved. Explicit View return types added (Illuminate\Contracts\View\View). Removed now-unused imports from routes/web.php (App\Models\{AuditLog,ConfigurationSession,QuotationRequest}); added the three controller imports.

=== NEW FK migration ===
database/migrations/2026_10_15_133133_add_foreign_keys_to_compatibility_rules.php. up() adds FKs for compatibility_rules.option_id and target_option_id -> attribute_options(id) cascadeOnDelete (mirrors sibling attribute_id FK). DRIVER-GUARDED: both up() and down() early-return when DB::connection()->getDriverName()==='sqlite' (sqlite cannot ALTER-add FKs; suite runs on sqlite :memory:), with PHPDoc explaining the limitation. Existing migration 2026_10_06_020000_create_components_and_rules_tables.php untouched. Suite migrates cleanly on sqlite (clean no-op there).

=== Test ===
tests/Feature/AdminIndexRoutesTest.php (Pest, seeds RolesAndPermissionsSeeder). Data-provider over the three route names: super_admin gets 200 (assertOk) on each; customer gets 403 (assertForbidden) on each. 6 cases pass. Phase 1 authorization preserved.

Pint clean (fixed blank_line_before_statement + function_declaration).
